lines.speaker: A
lines.text: शुभ संध्या। आपको कहाँ जाना है?
lines.say: shubh sandhyaa. aapko kahaan jaanaa hai?
lines.meaning: Good evening. Where do you want to travel?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: मुंबई का एक टिकट दीजिए। कितने का है?
lines.say: mumbayee kaa ek ticket deejiye. kitne kaa hai?
lines.meaning: One ticket to Mumbai, please. What is the price?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: चार सौ रुपये। गाड़ी छह बजे जाएगी।
lines.say: chaar sau rupaye. gaadee chhah baje jaayegee.
lines.meaning: It is four hundred rupees. The train leaves at six.

lines.speaker: B
lines.meaning: Which platform does the train go from?

lines.speaker: A
lines.meaning: Platform number three. Please be early.

lines.speaker: B
lines.meaning: Thank you. I will come early.
